question: Do both Qwen3-8B GGUF files serve with >= 64K KV tokens on a 16 GB RTX 5080 (M0.1 acceptance 6, design §4.7)?
settings: memory_fraction 0.98, max_step_tokens 2048, page_size 16, bf16 KV (144 KiB/token); max_seqs 64, stepped down to 48 for Q4_K_M on the measured shortfall below

breakdown_gib_q4_k_m.note: max_model_len 8192; the engine sizes KV as 0.98 x free memory after weights - worst-step peak - CUDA-graph pool
breakdown_gib_q4_k_m.max_step_tokens_1024_or_1536: no change (64112 KV tokens at max_seqs 64): the peak is the sampling step over every slot, not the prefill

runs.result: OutOfUnits: 8.768 GiB budget, KV needs 4097 pages of 16 tokens, 3990 fit

result: Both files serve 64K-token contexts on the RTX 5080: UD-IQ3_XXS at max_seqs 64 (75K KV tokens), Q4_K_M at max_seqs 48 (65.5K). The design's estimate of the graph pool (0.25 GiB) was low: 0.50 GiB at 64 decode buckets.
